cases.name: Maria Popol
cases.about:
She was a Guatemalan native who had recently celebrated her 23rd birthday and worked at a local restaurant. Margie Domiguez was Popol's co-worker for about 6-8 months at Don Leo Restaurant and Grocery in Telford, and she said she was a very hard worker. (Her cousin Edwin Popol said): “She had a big heart and always trying to help everyone. She never, never do anything to anybody because our parents, they educate us to do good things, not bad things.” Maria Popol worked as a server in a Latin American restaurant and grocery in Telford, where her coworkers described her as a woman with “many dreams and a kind heart.”

“We will always remember her for her warmth, dedication and the positive spirit she brought to those around her,”the  Don Leo restaurant posted on its Facebook page. “We are deeply saddened and still struggling to process this heartbreaking loss.”
cases.narrative: Edwin Popol said that the family was told his cousin was found stabbed to death in the apartment on the Bucks County side of Telford where she previously lived with her estranged boyfriend, who he alleged was abusive.
